clips.title: The story
paras: Abercrombie's Crate is a lost container of delicate tools and collected herbs belonging to the eccentric hermit Abercrombie. It rests abandoned near the entrance of the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound in southern Duskwood after the old man was chased off by marauding ogres.

While wandering far from his shack in western Duskwood to gather vegetation, Abercrombie crossed paths with a hostile gang of ogres. Fleeing for his life, the old hermit dropped his crate of precious instruments and harvested botanicals. The ogres hauled his belongings back to their stronghold at the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound, leaving the heavy chest sitting carelessly near their cave mouth.
